heading: SEBI Clears Automatic SWP, STP for Demat Mutual Funds
tldr: SEBI has now permitted automatic Systematic Withdrawal Plans (SWP) and Systematic Transfer Plans (STP) for mutual fund units held in demat accounts.
Previously, these automated facilities were exclusively available for mutual fund units maintained in the Statement of Account (SOA) format.
This regulatory update significantly enhances convenience for investors who prefer to consolidate all their financial assets in a single demat account.
It streamlines the process of managing regular income needs or portfolio rebalancing through automated transfers.
Investors can now enjoy similar operational flexibility for their demat-held mutual funds as they do for SOA-based holdings.
caption:
Good news for your investments! You can now set up automatic payments (like getting regular money out or moving it between funds) even if your mutual funds are in your demat account. Before, this was a bit tricky. This change makes managing your money much simpler and keeps everything in one place. Read the full article to understand how this helps you.
